description: This file defines TypeScript interfaces and functions for interacting with the Intercom API, including fetching contacts by email, creating contacts, and creating conversations.

methods.name: getContactByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a contact from Intercom by email address.

methods.name: createContact
methods.description: Creates a new contact in Intercom with provided data.

methods.name: createConversation
methods.description: Creates a new conversation in Intercom.
